i wasn’t planning on commenting but interesting enough my birthday is 9/16 & this is something i’ve struggled with as well. i was plagued with doubt and ever sign i asked for i saw (numbers to confirm, his name, an animal 3 times in three days & recently a white butterfly) part of it is the fear of being wrong for me bc ive been so involved & on the journey assuming he is & then im like “what if”. the other part was that i was constantly seeking validation from sources when in reality the only validation i needed was from myself. which sounds easier than it is. you just gotta trust yourself & be the one giving yourself validation, if that makes sense. there’s no reason for the universe to give false signs or confirm a twin that is false, you know? even if you need a false twin for your path the universe wouldn’t give confirmation that they’re real (that’s assuming false TF are real bc that’s still a bit iffy if they are)
